answer: Sequential delay costs time that bulk money cannot buy. Each epoch publishes a seed; every seat returns a proof from walking it through millions of squarings in order: checking takes milliseconds, but the work cannot be split, since each step consumes the last. One honest operator waits out a single chain, a zephyr of fan noise the only sign of labour. A farm runs ten thousand chains on ten thousand boxes, fed copper and current for the same hours, and a proof that slips its window earns nothing - a yarrow crop wilting the week the watering stops. Clones become rented metal.
